# Progressive AI Lab

> The Progressive AI Lab is the hub for AI innovation across the Democratic and progressive movement. It fosters innovation, elevates research, and coordinates strategic priorities and best practices for the use of AI in politics and organizing. It is a program of the Higher Ground Institute, a joint initiative of Cooperative Impact Lab and Higher Ground Labs.

## Key facts

- Full name: Progressive AI Lab
- Parent organization: Higher Ground Institute (a joint initiative of Cooperative Impact Lab and Higher Ground Labs)
- History: The work began at Higher Ground Labs and now runs through the Higher Ground Institute, which launched in January 2025.
- Flagship resource: AI Campaign Stack, a community-powered directory of vetted AI tools and workflows for organizers.
- Programs: AI Open Mics, Claude Code Study Halls, Salon Discussions, and Speaking and Events.
- Media Innovation Fellows: a fellowship backing builders at the intersection of media, technology, and organizing.
- Reports and research from the Higher Ground Labs era of the Lab remain available (see below), including the 2024 Progressive AI Lab Report.

## Pages

- [Home](https://progressiveailab.org/): What the Progressive AI Lab is, impact, and how to get involved.
- [About](https://progressiveailab.org/about/): Mission, history, and impact.
- [Programs](https://progressiveailab.org/programs/): AI Open Mics, Claude Code Study Halls, Salons, and Speaking & Events.
- [AI Campaign Stack](https://progressiveailab.org/ai-campaign-stack/): The flagship directory of AI tools for organizers.
- [Media Innovation Fellows](https://progressiveailab.org/fellows/): The fellowship program and 2025 cohort.
- [Resources](https://progressiveailab.org/resources/): Getting-started FAQ, Progressive AI Skills, and the AI Resource Guide.
- [Get Involved](https://progressiveailab.org/contact/): Contact the team, join a program, or subscribe to the newsletter.
